MTV begins broadcasting.
Einstein signs a letter urging the US to research the atomic bomb.
Christopher Columbus sets sail from Spain.
NASA's Phoenix lander launches toward Mars.
The first transatlantic telegraph cable is completed.
The first website goes public on the internet.
Philippe Petit walks a tightrope between the Twin Towers.
Thomas Edison patents the mimeograph copier.
Construction begins on the bell tower now known as the Leaning Tower of Pisa.
The Smithsonian Institution is founded.
A total solar eclipse sweeps across Europe.
IBM introduces the Personal Computer.
Harry Brearley creates stainless steel.
Paris orders the first car number plates.
The Woodstock festival begins.
Gold is discovered in the Klondike.
The first compact disc is manufactured in Germany.
Astronomers observing an eclipse discover helium in the Sun.
France announces the daguerreotype photography process.
Voyager 2 is launched.
The Mona Lisa is stolen from the Louvre.
The first Geneva Convention is signed.
Lunar Orbiter 1 takes the first picture of Earth from the Moon.
Pluto is reclassified as a dwarf planet.
Linus Torvalds announces the project that becomes Linux.
The 19th Amendment gives American women the vote.
Edwin Drake strikes oil in Pennsylvania.
Martin Luther King Jr. gives his "I Have a Dream" speech.
Michael Faraday discovers electromagnetic induction.
Space Shuttle Discovery makes its first flight.
Thomas Edison patents the Kinetoscope movie camera.
